ValidationRule.description: RB-12 - Prevents Integrated B2B Opportunities from being moved to Proposal, Onboarding or Won Stages when the Technical Scoping has not been completed.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( RecordType.DeveloperName = "Integrated_B2B", OR( ISPICKVAL(StageName, "Proposal & Negotiation"), ISPICKVAL(StageName, "Onboarding & Implementation"), ISPICKVAL(StageName, "Closed Won") ), NOT(Technical_Scoping_Complete__c) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Technical Scoping & Proposal Sent Date must be completed before Opportunity can be moved to “Proposal & Negotiation” or later stage.
